read-only-on-class.reason: NSView's tag is read-only on NSView itself (only NSControl and other subclasses set it), so the row on NSView can only connect

async-io.reason: GtkBookmarkList loads its construct-only file asynchronously; a bare instance reads the user's bookmarks

container-page.reason: a page object belongs to its container (gtk_notebook_get_page, gtk_stack_get_page); a bare GtkNotebookPage has no container to reorder it in, and a bare GtkStackPage crashes (the probe's crash list), so no test instance exists

deprecated-content.reason: the shortcuts window shows sections added from a builder file (gtk_shortcuts_window_add_section needs GTK 4.14 bindings this crate does not enable); a bare window has none to switch to

display-server.reason: changed by the window manager (activation) or needs a real display connection a test cannot fake

font-config.reason: the families of a font map change when the font configuration changes (fonts installed or added); no headless trigger, and the abstract font map types have no bare instance

gio-service.reason: needs a registered GApplication (gtk_application_add_window and gtk_application_set_menubar act on a registered application only), a D-Bus connection or a file monitor backend; no test instance is made for the last two

layout-child.reason: a layout child belongs to a layout manager and its child widget; on a bare GtkFixedLayoutChild (no manager) the set transform is dropped, and making a real one needs a GtkFixed with a child

list-view.reason: a tree list row, a list header and a tree list model's root exist only inside a list model or view that creates them; a bare instance has no model, so nothing can change them

media-backend.reason: GtkMediaStream and GtkMediaFile are abstract; gtk_media_file_new returns the media backend's private subclass (GtkNoMediaFile without GStreamer), which the backend's property tables do not name, so no test instance exists (no row)

newer-gtk.reason: GtkEnumList is not in GTK 4.22.4, the version the facts are made for (the probe found no type), so no row is generated

normalized-read.reason: a native set leaves the read value unchanged, so there is no change to observe (GtkPasswordEntry extra-menu reads its own wrapper menu, which stays the same object; GtkFileDialog initial-file reads back unchanged on a dialog that is not shown, GTK 4.22)

print-backend.reason: a print dialog or print job enumerates printers through the print backends (CUPS, file); the probe and the tests make no instance

realize.reason: the instance exists only once a widget or surface is realized (GL context, accessibility context, surface); the tests do not realize

stateless-instance.reason: GSimpleAction notifies state in g_simple_action_set_state, but a bare instance is stateless (state-type is construct-only), so the generated test has nothing to change

async-io.reason: changed by background loading, file IO, a media backend or the icon theme on disk

display-server.reason: changed by the display server, an input device or another client; no synthesizer without a real display (REACTIVITY section 4.4 keeps WM-driven causes manual)

gio-service.reason: needs a registered application, a D-Bus connection, a GSettings schema, a permission or file monitor backend

lazy-model.reason: a GListModel the widget creates on first read (weakly held); consumers observe the model's items-changed, not the property

list-view.reason: set by a list or column view while it binds rows, expands or sorts; needs a realized view

print-backend.reason: set by a print backend or a running print operation

realize.reason: changes when a surface, renderer or GL context is realized; the generated tests do not realize

stateless-instance.reason: GSimpleAction notifies state in g_simple_action_set_state, but a bare instance is stateless (state-type is construct-only), so the generated test has nothing to change

window-input.reason: set by layout, focus, pointer, drag-and-drop, settings or a user dialog in a mapped window; the generated tests neither map windows nor synthesize input

crashes-bare.reason: QDockWidget crashes on a bare instance (R0, R3), so no row is generated

no-element-or-type.reason: the class is neither an element nor an NT2 type, so the backend cannot reach it and the generated test has no row; no `bind:` can name these properties either

window-input.reason: focus and window activation need a window manager; offscreen/xcb without one gives no reliable headless focus or activation (R3)

edit-history.reason: changed by text edits, undo history or the clipboard; the generated rows have no trigger for them yet (a TextBox edit + Undo trigger in the WinUI harness would verify CanUndo/CanRedo)

input-state.reason: set by pointer input or focus (IsPointerOver, IsPressed, FocusState); the generated row has no UI Automation or input synthesizer for them, so it only connects

layout.reason: set by layout or by an items control that hosts the panel; no trigger in the generated rows

not-exposed.reason: the backend does not expose the property (brushes, templates, transitions, ...), so no row is generated and no `bind:` can name it (R4)
